info.description: Site-wide head metadata defaults: title template, description, share image, and social profiles

edit.label: Enabled
edit.description: Turns on rich head metadata (description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, JSON-LD, sitemap) for every page. Ships on by default.

edit.label: Title template
edit.description: %s is replaced by each page's title and {site} by the site name — e.g. "%s · {site}".

edit.label: Default description
edit.description: Used on any page that doesn't set its own description.

edit.label: Default share image
edit.description: Shown when a page is shared and doesn't set its own image (Open Graph + Twitter card).

edit.label: Redes sociais
edit.description: Social profile links and the Twitter card handle.
